income_statement.name: Revenue
income_statement.description: Revenue recognized during the reported period.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Shows the scale and growth of the core business.
income_statement.directionality: Higher is generally better when growth is profitable.

income_statement.name: Gross Profit
income_statement.why_it_matters: Funds operating expenses, investment, and profit.
income_statement.directionality: Higher and expanding is generally better.

income_statement.name: Operating Income
income_statement.description: Profit from core operations before interest and taxes.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Measures operating execution and cost discipline.

income_statement.name: Net Income
income_statement.description: Profit attributable after all recognized expenses.
income_statement.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.
income_statement.formula: Revenue − all expenses, interest, and tax

income_statement.name: Free Cash Flow
income_statement.why_it_matters: Provides context for operating performance, financial position, or valuation.
income_statement.directionality: Interpret with the company's trend, peers, and business model.
income_statement.formula: See the cited source and calculation context.

income_statement.name: Operating Cash Flow
income_statement.why_it_matters: Tests whether accounting earnings convert into cash.
income_statement.directionality: Higher and consistent is generally better.
income_statement.formula: Cash inflows from operations − operating cash outflows

income_statement.name: Capital Expenditures
income_statement.description: Cash or obligations used for long-lived productive assets.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Indicates reinvestment needs and pressure on free cash flow.
income_statement.directionality: Context dependent; efficiency matters more than simply lower or higher.

income_statement.name: Diluted EPS
income_statement.description: Earnings allocated to each diluted weighted-average share.
income_statement.why_it_matters: Connects company profit to shareholder economics.
income_statement.directionality: Higher sustainable EPS is generally better.

key_ratios.name: Gross Margin
key_ratios.description: Share of revenue remaining after direct costs.
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Shows product economics and pricing/cost performance.
key_ratios.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.

key_ratios.name: Operating Margin
key_ratios.description: Share of revenue retained as operating profit.
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Measures operating efficiency and pricing power.
key_ratios.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.

key_ratios.name: Net Margin
key_ratios.description: Share of revenue retained as net income.
key_ratios.directionality: Higher and durable is generally better.

key_ratios.name: SBC / Revenue
key_ratios.description: Stock-based compensation expense relative to revenue.
key_ratios.why_it_matters: Highlights equity-compensation intensity and potential dilution pressure.

valuation.name: P/S (Annualized)
valuation.why_it_matters: Shows how much equity investors are paying for each dollar of annualized sales. Useful when earnings are negative or too small for P/E to be meaningful.
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: EV / Revenue
valuation.why_it_matters: Tells you how much you are paying for one dollar of total sales, adjusting for debt and cash.
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: EV / Gross Profit
valuation.why_it_matters: Shows whether the core product is profitable to make before corporate overhead and management costs.
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: EV / Revenue / Growth
valuation.why_it_matters: Factors sales growth into the revenue multiple, functioning like a PEG ratio for top-line sales.
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: Forward P/E (NTM)
valuation.description: Current share price / consensus next-twelve-month diluted EPS.
valuation.why_it_matters: Shows the price paid today for expected next-twelve-month earnings.
valuation.formula: Share price ÷ consensus NTM diluted EPS
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: Trailing P/E
valuation.description: Market cap / trailing net income, or share price / trailing diluted EPS.
valuation.why_it_matters: Shows the price paid for profits generated over the trailing twelve months.
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: EV / EBITDA
valuation.why_it_matters: Compares the total business value with operating earning power before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization.
valuation.source_note: robinhood-trading MCP regular-session last trade; SEC filing/XBRL

valuation.name: Levered FCF Yield
valuation.description: FCF available to common equity / market cap.
valuation.why_it_matters: Shows the cash return generated for common shareholders relative to the stock's market value.
